# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper Functions
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

inv_logit <- function(x) 1 / (1 + exp(-x))

net_benefit <- function(treat, outcome, pt) {
  treat <- as.integer(treat)
  outcome <- as.integer(outcome)

  keep <- !is.na(treat) & !is.na(outcome)
  treat <- treat[keep]
  outcome <- outcome[keep]

  n <- length(outcome)
  if (n == 0) return(NA_real_)

  w <- pt / (1 - pt)
  tp <- sum(treat == 1 & outcome == 1)
  fp <- sum(treat == 1 & outcome == 0)

  (tp / n) - (fp / n) * w
}

nb_screen_all <- function(outcome, pt) {
  outcome <- as.integer(outcome)
  outcome <- outcome[!is.na(outcome)]
  n <- length(outcome)
  if (n == 0) return(NA_real_)

  prev <- mean(outcome)
  w <- pt / (1 - pt)
  prev - (1 - prev) * w
}

nb_screen_none <- function() 0

delta_nb <- function(dat, cutoff, pt, comparator = c("all", "none")) {
  comparator <- match.arg(comparator)

  treat <- as.integer(dat$age > cutoff)
  outcome <- as.integer(dat$outcome)

  nb_strat <- net_benefit(treat, outcome, pt)

  nb_comp <- switch(
    comparator,
    all = nb_screen_all(outcome, pt),
    none = nb_screen_none()
  )

  nb_strat - nb_comp
}

fit_re_meta <- function(yi, vi) {
  if (length(yi) < 2) return(NULL)
  tryCatch(
    metafor::rma(yi = yi, vi = vi, method = "REML"),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
}

extract_meta_stats <- function(model) {
  if (is.null(model)) {
    return(tibble(
      pooled = NA_real_,
      ci_lb = NA_real_,
      ci_ub = NA_real_,
      pi_lb = NA_real_,
      pi_ub = NA_real_,
      tau2 = NA_real_,
      i2 = NA_real_,
      q = NA_real_,
      q_p = NA_real_,
      k = NA_integer_
    ))
  }

  pred <- metafor::predict.rma(model)

  tibble(
    pooled = unname(pred$pred),
    ci_lb = unname(pred$ci.lb),
    ci_ub = unname(pred$ci.ub),
    pi_lb = unname(pred$pi.lb),
    pi_ub = unname(pred$pi.ub),
    tau2 = unname(model$tau2),
    i2 = unname(model$I2),
    q = unname(model$QE),
    q_p = unname(model$QEp),
    k = unname(model$k)
  )
}

fmt_num <- function(x, digits = 3) {
  ifelse(is.finite(x), formatC(x, digits = digits, format = "f"), "NA")
}

fmt_p <- function(p) {
  p <- as.numeric(p)
  ifelse(
    !is.finite(p),
    "NA",
    ifelse(
      p < 0.001,
      "<0.001",
      formatC(p, digits = 3, format = "f")
    )
  )
}

re_weight_pct <- function(vi, tau2) {
  vi <- as.numeric(vi)
  tau2 <- as.numeric(tau2)
  if (!is.finite(tau2)) return(rep(NA_real_, length(vi)))
  if (any(!is.finite(vi))) return(rep(NA_real_, length(vi)))
  w <- 1 / (vi + tau2)
  100 * w / sum(w)
}

save_funnel_and_bias <- function(model, file, title, xlab = "Effect") {
  if (is.null(model) || !is.finite(model$k) || model$k < 2) return(invisible(NULL))

  grDevices::png(file, width = 2200, height = 1600, res = 300)
  on.exit(grDevices::dev.off(), add = TRUE)

  metafor::funnel(model, main = title, xlab = xlab, yaxis = "seinv")
  invisible(NULL)
}

find_zero_crossings <- function(x, y) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  y <- as.numeric(y)
  keep <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
  x <- x[keep]
  y <- y[keep]
  if (length(x) < 2) return(numeric(0))

  o <- order(x)
  x <- x[o]
  y <- y[o]

  crossings <- numeric(0)
  for (i in seq_len(length(x) - 1)) {
    x1 <- x[i]; x2 <- x[i + 1]
    y1 <- y[i]; y2 <- y[i + 1]

    if (y1 == 0) {
      crossings <- c(crossings, x1)
      next
    }
    if ((y1 < 0 && y2 > 0) || (y1 > 0 && y2 < 0) || y2 == 0) {
      if (y2 == 0) {
        crossings <- c(crossings, x2)
      } else {
        # Linear interpolation for y=0
        crossings <- c(crossings, x1 + (0 - y1) * (x2 - x1) / (y2 - y1))
      }
    }
  }

  unique(round(crossings, 6))
}

forest_plot_simple <- function(
  df,
  pooled_row,
  title,
  file,
  x_label,
  x_limits = NULL,
  x_breaks = NULL,
  x_labels = NULL,
  x_trans = "identity",
  ref_line = NULL,
  ref_linetype = "solid",
  caption = NULL
) {
  # Prepare data
  df_plot <- df %>%
    mutate(
      study_label = as.character(study),
      type = "study",
      weight_val = if("weight_pct" %in% names(.)) weight_pct else 1,
      size_val = weight_val  # Size proportional to weight
    )

  # Check if metadata columns exist for extended labels
  if ("custom_label" %in% names(df)) {
     df_plot <- df_plot %>% mutate(study_label = custom_label)
  } else if ("recruitment" %in% names(df)) {
     df_plot <- df_plot %>%
       mutate(study_label = paste0(study, " (", recruitment, ")"))
  }

  pooled_plot <- pooled_row %>%
    mutate(
      study_label = "Pooled (REML)",
      type = "pooled",
      weight_val = NA_real_, 
      size_val = NA_real_ # Pooled diamond dealt with separately
    )

  # Combine
  combined <- bind_rows(df_plot, pooled_plot) %>%
    mutate(
      # Order: Pooled at bottom, then studies in reverse alphabetical or provided order
      # If study column is already a factor, preserve order; else sort
      study_orig = study_label
    )
    
  # SORTING BY EFFECT SIZE (estimate)
  # Arrange studies by estimate
  # The user wants "Ascending" order. Assuming small effect at top?
  # Let's try arrange(estimate). This puts Small -> Large.
  # So study_levs = A(0.5), B(1.0), C(2.0).
  # rev(study_levs) = C, B, A.
  # Levels = Pooled, C, B, A.
  # Y=1 Pooled, Y=2 C, Y=3 B, Y=4 A.
  # Plot: A (Top), B, C, Pooled.
  # This is Ascending down: 0.5 -> 1.0 -> 2.0.
  df_sorted <- df_plot %>% arrange(estimate) 
  
  study_levs <- df_sorted$study_label
  
  # final_levels: 1=Pooled, 2=Large, ..., N=Small.
  final_levels <- c("Pooled (REML)", rev(study_levs))
  
  combined <- combined %>%
    mutate(
      study_factor = factor(study_label, levels = final_levels),
      y_pos = as.integer(study_factor)
    )
    
  # Safety check: if any NA y_pos, assign them temporary placement to avoid error, but warn
  if(any(is.na(combined$y_pos))) {
     combined$y_pos[is.na(combined$y_pos)] <- length(final_levels) + 1
  }

  # Text labels for Forest Plot
  combined <- combined %>%
    mutate(
      est_txt = fmt_num(estimate, 2),
      ci_txt = paste0("[", fmt_num(ci_lb, 2), ", ", fmt_num(ci_ub, 2), "]"),
      weight_txt = ifelse(type == "pooled", "100.0%", paste0(formatC(weight_val, digits = 1, format = "f"), "%")),
      label_right = paste0(est_txt, " ", ci_txt)
    )

  # Diamond polygon for pooled
  # Width = CI
  # Height = fixed, e.g. 0.3 units
  poly_h <- 0.3
  pooled_y <- 1
  
  diamond_df <- tibble(
    x = c(pooled_row$ci_lb, pooled_row$estimate, pooled_row$ci_ub, pooled_row$estimate),
    y = c(pooled_y, pooled_y + poly_h, pooled_y, pooled_y - poly_h),
    group = 1
  )

  pi_df <- NULL
  if (all(c("pi_lb", "pi_ub") %in% names(pooled_row))) {
    pi_lb <- pooled_row$pi_lb
    pi_ub <- pooled_row$pi_ub
    if (is.finite(pi_lb) && is.finite(pi_ub) && (pi_lb < pi_ub)) {
      pi_df <- tibble(
        estimate = pooled_row$estimate,
        pi_lb = pi_lb,
        pi_ub = pi_ub,
        y_pos = pooled_y
      )
    }
  }

  # Heterogeneity Stats in Caption
  het_text <- ""
  if ("tau2" %in% names(pooled_row) && !is.na(pooled_row$tau2)) {
     het_text <- paste0(
        "Heterogeneity: Tau\u00b2 = ", fmt_num(pooled_row$tau2, 2), 
        "; Chi\u00b2 = ", fmt_num(pooled_row$q, 1), 
        ", df = ", pooled_row$k - 1, 
        " (P = ", fmt_p(pooled_row$q_p), "); ",
        "I\u00b2 = ", fmt_num(pooled_row$i2, 0), "%"
     )
  }
  
  full_caption <- if(is.null(caption)) het_text else paste0(caption, "\n", het_text)

  # --- DYNAMIC PLOT LIMITS & TEXT PLACEMENT ---
  max_ci <- max(combined$ci_ub, na.rm = TRUE)
  min_ci <- min(combined$ci_lb, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Safe min for log
  if (x_trans == "log10") {
      if(min_ci <= 0) min_ci <- min(combined$ci_lb[combined$ci_lb > 0], na.rm = TRUE)
  }

  # Targets for plot limits (what shows on axis)
  if (is.null(x_limits)) {
    if (x_trans == "log10") {
      # Expand slightly: min/1.5, max*1.5
      targets <- c(min_ci / 1.5, max_ci * 1.5)
    } else {
      # Linear axis: avoid forcing 0 into view for ratio measures (e.g., OR)
      targets <- c(min_ci, max_ci)

      include_zero <- isTRUE(ref_line == 0) || (min_ci < 0)
      if (include_zero) targets[1] <- min(0, targets[1])
    }
  } else {
    targets <- x_limits
  }
  
  # Calculate Text Positions outside the plot area
  if (x_trans == "log10") {
    log_min <- log10(targets[1])
    log_max <- log10(targets[2])
    log_range <- log_max - log_min

    # Place Effect text at ~10% beyond right edge (in log spacing)
    pos_est <- 10^(log_max + 0.05 * log_range)
    # Place Weight text closer to the right edge (avoid clipping)
    pos_wt <- 10^(log_max + 0.30 * log_range)

    # Place study header in the left gutter (outside plotting region)
    pos_study_hdr <- 10^(log_min - 0.40 * log_range)
  } else {
    lin_range <- targets[2] - targets[1]
    pos_est <- targets[2] + 0.05 * lin_range
    pos_wt <- targets[2] + 0.30 * lin_range

    # Place study header in the left gutter (outside plotting region)
    pos_study_hdr <- targets[1] - 0.40 * lin_range
  }

  # Create plot
  p <- ggplot(combined, aes(y = y_pos)) +
    # Vertical Reference Line
    {if (!is.null(ref_line)) geom_vline(xintercept = ref_line, color = "black", linetype = ref_linetype) } +
    
    # Study Error Bars
    geom_errorbarh(
      data = filter(combined, type == "study"),
      aes(xmin = ci_lb, xmax = ci_ub, x = estimate),
      height = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.6
    ) +
    
    # Study Squares
    geom_point(
      data = filter(combined, type == "study"),
      aes(x = estimate, size = size_val),
      shape = 22, fill = "black", color = "black"
    ) +

    # Prediction interval (optional) behind pooled diamond
    {if (!is.null(pi_df)) geom_errorbarh(
      data = pi_df,
      aes(xmin = pi_lb, xmax = pi_ub, x = estimate, y = y_pos),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      height = 0.18,
      color = "black",
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.6
    ) } +
    
    # Pooled Diamond
    geom_polygon(data = diamond_df, aes(x = x, y = y), fill = "black", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    
    scale_size_area(max_size = 6, guide = "none") + 
    
    # Text Columns - Using calculated positions
    geom_text(aes(x = pos_est, label = label_right), hjust = 0, size = 3.8) +
    geom_text(aes(x = pos_wt, label = weight_txt), hjust = 0, size = 3.8) +
    annotate("text", x = pos_est, y = length(final_levels) + 1, label = "Effect [95% CI]", hjust = 0, fontface = "bold", size = 4.2) +
    annotate("text", x = pos_wt, y = length(final_levels) + 1, label = "Weight", hjust = 0, fontface = "bold", size = 4.2) +
    annotate("text", x = pos_study_hdr, y = length(final_levels) + 1, label = "Study (Years recruited)", hjust = 0, fontface = "bold", size = 4.2) +

    scale_x_continuous(
      name = x_label,
      trans = x_trans, 
      breaks = if (!is.null(x_breaks)) x_breaks else if (x_trans == "log10") scales::log_breaks(n = 6) else scales::pretty_breaks(n = 6),
      labels = if (!is.null(x_labels)) x_labels else scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.01)
    ) +
    
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = 1:length(final_levels),
      labels = final_levels,
      expand = expansion(mult = 0.05)
    ) +
    
    # Coordinate system with clipping off
    coord_cartesian(xlim = targets, clip = "off") +
    
    labs(
      title = title,
      y = NULL,
      caption = full_caption
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      axis.line.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 12),
      plot.caption.position = "plot",
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0, margin = margin(t = 8, l = 6)),
      plot.margin = margin(12, 280, 12, 120)
    )

  ggsave(file, plot = p, width = 13.5, height = 6.5 + 0.35 * length(study_levs), dpi = 300)
  p
}

plot_subgroup_dca <- function(meta_res) {
  df <- meta_res$meta %>%
    filter(!is.na(pooled)) 
    
  colors <- c(
    "Screen All" = "black",
    "Screen None" = "black",
    "Age > 35" = "#1b9e77",
    "Age > 40" = "#d95f02",
    "Age > 45" = "#7570b3"
  )
  
  linetypes <- c(
    "Screen All" = "solid",
    "Screen None" = "dotted",
    "Age > 35" = "solid",
    "Age > 40" = "solid",
    "Age > 45" = "solid"
  )
  
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(strategy = factor(strategy, levels = c("Screen All", "Screen None", "Age > 35", "Age > 40", "Age > 45")))

  plot_title <- meta_res$level
  
  if (meta_res$name == "HBV") {
    if (meta_res$level == "Negative") plot_title <- "HBV non-reactive"
    if (meta_res$level == "Positive") plot_title <- "HBV reactive"
  } else if (meta_res$name == "HIV") {
    if (meta_res$level == "Negative") plot_title <- "HIV non-reactive"
    if (meta_res$level == "Positive") plot_title <- "HIV reactive"
  } else if (meta_res$name == "Hazardous alcohol use") {
    if (meta_res$level == "No") plot_title <- "No hazardous alcohol use"
    if (meta_res$level == "Yes") plot_title <- "Hazardous alcohol use"
  } else if (meta_res$name == "Obesity") {
    # Keep as is
  } else if (meta_res$name == "Aboriginal") {
    # Keep as is
  } else if (meta_res$name == "Gender") {
    # Keep as is
  }

  if (!is.null(meta_res$n)) {
    plot_title <- paste0(plot_title, "\n(N=", meta_res$n, ")")
  }

  df <- df %>% arrange(strategy, threshold)

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = threshold, y = pooled, color = strategy, linetype = strategy, group = strategy)) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE, span = 0.6, linewidth = 1) +
    coord_cartesian(
        xlim = c(0, 0.3),
        ylim = c(-0.01, max(0.1, max(df$pooled, na.rm=TRUE) * 1.05))
    ) + 
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 0.3, 0.05)) +
    labs(
      title = plot_title,
      x = "Threshold Probability", 
      y = "Net Benefit",
      color = "Strategy",
      linetype = "Strategy"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = linetypes) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
       legend.position = "bottom",
       plot.title = element_text(face="bold", hjust=0.5, size=11),
       axis.title = element_text(size=10),
       axis.text = element_text(size=9)
    )
    
  return(p)
}

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Analysis Function (Outcome-Agnostic)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

run_full_analysis <- function(data, outcome_col_name, analysis_label, file_suffix) {
  
  cat(paste0("\n\n>>> STARTING ANALYSIS: ", analysis_label, " <<<\n\n"))
  
  # Ensure outcome exists and filter strictly
  cohort_analysis <- data %>%
    mutate(outcome = !!sym(outcome_col_name)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(outcome))
    
  # 1. Prevalence
  prev_tbl <- cohort_analysis %>%
    group_by(study) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      events = sum(outcome == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      prev = events / n,
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  write_csv(prev_tbl, paste0("Results/Metaanalysis/Meta_StudyPrevalence_", file_suffix, ".csv"))
  
  prev_es <- metafor::escalc(measure = "PLO", xi = prev_tbl$events, ni = prev_tbl$n, slab = prev_tbl$study, add = 0.5, to = "only0")
  prev_re <- fit_re_meta(prev_es$yi, prev_es$vi)
  
  if (!is.null(prev_re)) {
    prev_stats <- extract_meta_stats(prev_re) %>%
      mutate(
        pooled_prev = inv_logit(pooled),
        pooled_prev_ci_lb = inv_logit(ci_lb),
        pooled_prev_ci_ub = inv_logit(ci_ub)
      )
      
    prev_weight_pct <- re_weight_pct(prev_es$vi, prev_re$tau2)

    prev_study_forest <- prev_es %>%
      { tibble(study = prev_tbl$study, yi = . $yi, vi = . $vi, weight_pct = prev_weight_pct) } %>%
      left_join(study_metadata, by="study") %>% 
      mutate(
        custom_label = paste0(study, " (", recruitment, ")")
      ) %>%
      transmute(
        study,
        estimate = inv_logit(yi),
        ci_lb = inv_logit(yi - 1.96 * sqrt(vi)),
        ci_ub = inv_logit(yi + 1.96 * sqrt(vi)),
        weight_pct,
        custom_label
      )
      
    prev_pooled_row <- prev_stats %>%
      mutate(
        estimate = pooled_prev,
        ci_lb = pooled_prev_ci_lb,
        ci_ub = pooled_prev_ci_ub,
        pi_lb = inv_logit(pi_lb),
        pi_ub = inv_logit(pi_ub)
      )
    
    forest_plot_simple(
      df = prev_study_forest, pooled_row = prev_pooled_row,
      title = paste0("Study prevalence of ", analysis_label, " (pooled RE)"),
      file = paste0("Results/Metaanalysis/Forest_Prevalence_", file_suffix, ".png"),
      x_label = "Prevalence", x_limits = c(0, 0.5),
      caption = paste0("Pooled: ", fmt_num(prev_stats$pooled_prev, 3))
    )

    save_funnel_and_bias(
      model = prev_re,
      file = paste0("Results/Metaanalysis/Funnel_Prevalence_", file_suffix, ".png"),
      title = paste0("Funnel plot: prevalence of ", analysis_label),
      xlab = "Logit prevalence"
    )

    prev_egger <- tryCatch(metafor::regtest(prev_re, model = "rma"), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(prev_egger)) {
      write_csv(
        tibble(
          analysis = analysis_label,
          type = "prevalence",
          k = prev_re$k,
          z = unname(prev_egger$zval),
          p = unname(prev_egger$pval)
        ),
        paste0("Results/Metaanalysis/BiasTest_Prevalence_", file_suffix, ".csv")
      )
    }
  }

  # 2. Age Effect (OR per 5 years)
  age_effect_tbl <- cohort_analysis %>%
    group_by(study) %>%
    group_modify(~ {
      dat <- .x
      if (n_distinct(dat$outcome) < 2) return(tibble(log_or_per5 = NA_real_, se = NA_real_))
      
      fit <- tryCatch(
        glm(outcome ~ I(age / 5), data = dat, family = binomial()),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      if (is.null(fit)) return(tibble(log_or_per5 = NA_real_, se = NA_real_))
      s <- coef(summary(fit))
      if (!"I(age/5)" %in% rownames(s)) return(tibble(log_or_per5 = NA_real_, se = NA_real_))
      
      est <- unname(s["I(age/5)", "Estimate"])
      se <- unname(s["I(age/5)", "Std. Error"])
      if (abs(est) > 10 || se > 10) return(tibble(log_or_per5 = NA_real_, se = NA_real_))
      
      tibble(log_or_per5 = est, se = se)
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(!is.na(log_or_per5)) %>%
    mutate(vi = se^2)
    
  write_csv(age_effect_tbl, paste0("Results/Metaanalysis/Meta_StudyAgeEffect_", file_suffix, ".csv"))
  
  age_re <- fit_re_meta(age_effect_tbl$log_or_per5, age_effect_tbl$vi)
  if (!is.null(age_re)) {
    age_stats <- extract_meta_stats(age_re) %>% mutate(or = exp(pooled), or_ci_lb = exp(ci_lb), or_ci_ub = exp(ci_ub))
    write_csv(age_stats, paste0("Results/Metaanalysis/Meta_StudyAgeEffect_Summary_", file_suffix, ".csv"))
    
    age_weight_pct <- re_weight_pct(age_effect_tbl$vi, age_re$tau2)

    age_study_forest <- age_effect_tbl %>%
      mutate(weight_pct = age_weight_pct) %>%
      left_join(study_metadata, by="study") %>%
      mutate(
        custom_label = paste0(study, " (", recruitment, ")")
      ) %>%
      transmute(
        study,
        estimate = exp(log_or_per5),
        ci_lb = exp(log_or_per5 - 1.96 * se),
        ci_ub = exp(log_or_per5 + 1.96 * se),
        weight_pct,
        custom_label
      )
      
    age_pooled_row <- age_stats %>%
      mutate(
        estimate = exp(pooled),
        ci_lb = exp(ci_lb),
        ci_ub = exp(ci_ub),
        pi_lb = exp(pi_lb),
        pi_ub = exp(pi_ub)
      )
    
    forest_plot_simple(
      df = age_study_forest, pooled_row = age_pooled_row,
      title = paste0("Age effect on ", analysis_label, " (OR per 5 years)"),
      file = paste0("Results/Metaanalysis/Forest_AgeEffect_", file_suffix, ".png"),
      x_label = "Odds ratio",
      x_limits = c(0, 10),
      x_breaks = c(0, 1:10),
      x_labels = c("0", as.character(1:10)),
      x_trans = "identity",
      ref_line = 1,
      ref_linetype = "dotted",
      caption = paste0("Pooled OR: ", fmt_num(exp(age_stats$pooled), 2))
    )

    save_funnel_and_bias(
      model = age_re,
      file = paste0("Results/Metaanalysis/Funnel_AgeEffect_", file_suffix, ".png"),
      title = paste0("Funnel plot: age effect on ", analysis_label),
      xlab = "Log OR (per 5y)"
    )

    age_egger <- tryCatch(metafor::regtest(age_re, model = "rma"), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(age_egger)) {
      write_csv(
        tibble(
          analysis = analysis_label,
          type = "age_effect",
          k = age_re$k,
          z = unname(age_egger$zval),
          p = unname(age_egger$pval)
        ),
        paste0("Results/Metaanalysis/BiasTest_AgeEffect_", file_suffix, ".csv")
      )
    }
  }

  # 3. Delta Net Benefit
  meta_inputs <- crossing(
    study = sort(unique(cohort_analysis$study)),
    cutoff = age_cutoffs,
    threshold = thresholds,
    comparator = "all"
  ) %>%
    mutate(estimate = NA_real_, se = NA_real_, nb_strategy = NA_real_, nb_screen_all = NA_real_, se_nb_strategy = NA_real_)

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(meta_inputs))) {
    st <- meta_inputs$study[i]
    cutoff <- meta_inputs$cutoff[i]
    pt <- meta_inputs$threshold[i]
    comp <- meta_inputs$comparator[i]

    dat <- cohort_analysis %>% filter(study == st) %>% select(age, outcome)
    if (nrow(dat) == 0) next
    
    treat <- as.integer(dat$age > cutoff)
    meta_inputs$nb_strategy[i] <- net_benefit(treat, dat$outcome, pt)
    meta_inputs$nb_screen_all[i] <- nb_screen_all(dat$outcome, pt)
      
    if (is.finite(meta_inputs$nb_strategy[i])) {
      # se_nb_strategy (raw NB)
      vals_raw <- replicate(50, { 
         idx <- sample.int(nrow(dat), nrow(dat), replace=TRUE)
         treat_b <- treat[idx]; out_b <- dat$outcome[idx]
         net_benefit(treat_b, out_b, pt)
      })
      meta_inputs$se_nb_strategy[i] <- sd(vals_raw, na.rm=TRUE)
      
      # se (Delta NB)
      vals_delta <- replicate(50, {
         idx <- sample.int(nrow(dat), nrow(dat), replace=TRUE)
         treat_b <- treat[idx]; out_b <- dat$outcome[idx]
         nb1 <- net_benefit(treat_b, out_b, pt)
         nb2 <- nb_screen_all(out_b, pt)
         nb1 - nb2
      })
      meta_inputs$estimate[i] <- meta_inputs$nb_strategy[i] - meta_inputs$nb_screen_all[i] # Point estimate
      meta_inputs$se[i] <- sd(vals_delta, na.rm=TRUE)
    }
  }

  meta_inputs <- meta_inputs %>%
    mutate(
      strategy = paste0("Age > ", cutoff),
      vi = se^2,
      vi_nb = se_nb_strategy^2,
      ci_lb = estimate - 1.96 * se,
      ci_ub = estimate + 1.96 * se
    )

  write_csv(meta_inputs, paste0("Results/Metaanalysis/Meta_DeltaNB_", file_suffix, "_Data.csv"))

  # 4. Meta-Analyze NB (Raw) for DCA Curves
  meta_nb_summary <- meta_inputs %>%
    filter(is.finite(nb_strategy), is.finite(vi_nb), vi_nb > 0) %>%
    group_by(strategy, threshold) %>%
    group_modify(~ {
      m <- fit_re_meta(.x$nb_strategy, .x$vi_nb)
      extract_meta_stats(m)
    }) %>% ungroup() %>% rename(nb_pooled = pooled, nb_ci_lb = ci_lb, nb_ci_ub = ci_ub)

  screen_all_inputs <- meta_inputs %>% select(study, threshold) %>% distinct() %>% mutate(nb_all = NA_real_, vi_all = NA_real_)
  
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(screen_all_inputs))) {
    st <- screen_all_inputs$study[i]; pt <- screen_all_inputs$threshold[i]
    dat <- cohort_analysis %>% filter(study == st) %>% select(outcome)
    if (nrow(dat) > 0) {
      screen_all_inputs$nb_all[i] <- nb_screen_all(dat$outcome, pt)
      p <- mean(dat$outcome); w <- pt/(1-pt); n <- nrow(dat)
      screen_all_inputs$vi_all[i] <- ((1+w)^2) * (p*(1-p)/n)
    }
  }
  
  meta_all_summary <- screen_all_inputs %>%
    filter(is.finite(nb_all), is.finite(vi_all), vi_all > 0) %>%
    group_by(threshold) %>%
    group_modify(~ {
      m <- fit_re_meta(.x$nb_all, .x$vi_all)
      extract_meta_stats(m)
    }) %>% ungroup() %>% rename(nb_pooled = pooled, nb_ci_lb = ci_lb, nb_ci_ub = ci_ub) %>% mutate(strategy = "Screen All")
  
  all_nb_meta <- bind_rows(
    meta_nb_summary %>% select(strategy, threshold, nb_pooled, nb_ci_lb, nb_ci_ub),
    meta_all_summary %>% select(strategy, threshold, nb_pooled, nb_ci_lb, nb_ci_ub),
    tibble(strategy = "Screen None", threshold = unique(meta_nb_summary$threshold), nb_pooled = 0, nb_ci_lb = 0, nb_ci_ub = 0)
  )

  write_csv(
    all_nb_meta %>% arrange(strategy, threshold),
    paste0("Results/Metaanalysis/Meta_PooledNB_", file_suffix, ".csv")
  )

  # Identify where pooled NB(strategy) crosses pooled NB(Screen All)
  screen_all_curve <- all_nb_meta %>%
    filter(strategy == "Screen All") %>%
    select(threshold, nb_screen_all = nb_pooled)

  diff_vs_all <- all_nb_meta %>%
    filter(strategy != "Screen All") %>%
    left_join(screen_all_curve, by = "threshold") %>%
    mutate(nb_diff_vs_screen_all = nb_pooled - nb_screen_all)

  crossings_tbl <- diff_vs_all %>%
    group_by(strategy) %>%
    summarise(
      crossing_thresholds = {
        xs <- find_zero_crossings(threshold, nb_diff_vs_screen_all)
        if (length(xs) == 0) NA_character_ else paste0(xs, collapse = ";")
      },
      first_crossing = {
        xs <- find_zero_crossings(threshold, nb_diff_vs_screen_all)
        if (length(xs) == 0) NA_real_ else min(xs)
      },
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  write_csv(
    crossings_tbl,
    paste0("Results/Metaanalysis/Meta_PooledNB_CrossesScreenAll_", file_suffix, ".csv")
  )
  
  all_nb_meta_plot <- all_nb_meta %>% arrange(strategy, threshold)

  p_dca_main <- ggplot(all_nb_meta_plot, aes(x = threshold, y = nb_pooled, color = strategy, linetype = strategy, group = strategy)) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE, span = 0.6, linewidth = 1) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 0.3), ylim = c(-0.01, max(0.1, max(all_nb_meta$nb_pooled, na.rm=TRUE) * 1.05))) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 0.3, 0.05)) +
    labs(title = paste0("Overall Cohort: ", analysis_label), x = "Threshold Probability", y = "Net Benefit", color="Strategy", linetype="Strategy") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Screen All"="black", "Screen None"="black", "Age > 35"="#1b9e77", "Age > 40"="#d95f02", "Age > 45"="#7570b3")) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Screen All"="solid", "Screen None"="dotted", "Age > 35"="solid", "Age > 40"="solid", "Age > 45"="solid")) +
    theme_classic() + theme(legend.position = "bottom")

  ggsave(paste0("Results/Metaanalysis/Meta_DCA_Overall_", file_suffix, ".png"), p_dca_main, width = 8, height = 6)
  
  # 5. SUBGROUP DCA (Panel Logic)
  
  subgroups <- list(
    list(name = "Gender", levels = c("Male", "Female")),
    list(name = "Aboriginal", levels = c("Indigenous", "Non-Indigenous")),
    list(name = "HIV", levels = c("Negative", "Positive")),
    list(name = "HBV", levels = c("Negative", "Positive")),
    list(name = "Hazardous alcohol use", levels = c("No", "Yes")),
    list(name = "Obesity", levels = c("Not obese (BMI < 30)", "Obese (BMI >= 30)"))
  )
  
  calc_sg_dca <- function(d, lvl_name) {
    strats <- bind_rows(tibble(strat="Screen All", cut=NA), tibble(strat=paste0("Age > ", age_cutoffs), cut=age_cutoffs))
    studies_sg <- unique(d$study)
    res_list <- list()
    t_vals <- thresholds
    
    for(ss in studies_sg) {
      d_s <- d %>% filter(study == ss)
      if(nrow(d_s) < 20) next
      for(pt in t_vals) {
        for(k in 1:nrow(strats)) {
          st_lab <- strats$strat[k]; st_cut <- strats$cut[k]
          if(st_lab == "Screen All") treat <- rep(1L, nrow(d_s)) else treat <- as.integer(d_s$age > st_cut)
          
          # Compute NB
          val <- net_benefit(treat, d_s$outcome, pt)
          
          boots <- replicate(20, {
             ix <- sample.int(nrow(d_s), nrow(d_s), T)
             tr <- if(st_lab == "Screen All") rep(1L, nrow(d_s)) else as.integer(d_s$age[ix] > st_cut)
             net_benefit(tr, d_s$outcome[ix], pt)
          })
          se <- sd(boots, na.rm=TRUE)

          if(is.finite(val) & is.finite(se)) {
             # If se is 0 (e.g. constant 0 events), add tiny epsilon to allow meta-analysis
             vi_val <- if(se == 0) 1e-10 else se^2
             res_list[[length(res_list)+1]] <- tibble(study=ss, threshold=pt, strategy=st_lab, nb=val, vi=vi_val)
          }
        }
      }
    }
    
    if(length(res_list)==0) return(NULL)
    bind_rows(res_list) %>%
      group_by(threshold, strategy) %>%
      group_modify(~ {
        if(nrow(.x) < 2) return(tibble(pooled=mean(.x$nb), ci_lb=NA, ci_ub=NA))
        m <- fit_re_meta(.x$nb, .x$vi)
        if (is.null(m)) {
           # Fallback if meta-analysis fails (e.g. all 0 variance)
           return(tibble(pooled=mean(.x$nb), ci_lb=NA, ci_ub=NA))
        }
        extract_meta_stats(m) %>% select(pooled, ci_lb, ci_ub)
      }) %>% ungroup() %>%
      bind_rows(tibble(threshold=unique(.$threshold), strategy="Screen None", pooled=0, ci_lb=0, ci_ub=0))
  }
  
  all_plots <- list()
  panel_data <- tibble()
  
  p_main_copy <- p_dca_main + labs(title = "Overall Cohort")
  all_plots[["Overall"]] <- p_main_copy
  panel_data <- bind_rows(panel_data, all_nb_meta %>% mutate(subgroup="Overall", level="Overall"))

  for (sg in subgroups) {
    for (lvl in sg$levels) {
      
      dat_sub <- NULL
      if (sg$name == "Gender") dat_sub <- cohort_analysis %>% filter(gender == lvl)
      else if (sg$name == "Aboriginal") dat_sub <- cohort_analysis %>% filter(aboriginal == lvl)
      else if (sg$name == "HIV") dat_sub <- cohort_analysis %>% filter(hiv == lvl)
      else if (sg$name == "HBV") dat_sub <- cohort_analysis %>% filter(hbv == lvl)
      else if (sg$name == "Hazardous alcohol use") dat_sub <- cohort_analysis %>% filter(hazardous_alcohol_use == lvl)
      else if (sg$name == "Obesity") {
         if (str_detect(lvl, "< 30")) dat_sub <- cohort_analysis %>% filter(bmi < 30)
         else dat_sub <- cohort_analysis %>% filter(bmi >= 30)
      }
      
      if (!is.null(dat_sub) && nrow(dat_sub) > 50) {
        n_sub <- nrow(dat_sub)
        meta_res <- calc_sg_dca(dat_sub, lvl)
        if (!is.null(meta_res)) {
           p <- plot_subgroup_dca(list(meta=meta_res, name=sg$name, level=lvl, n=n_sub))
           key <- paste(sg$name, lvl, sep="_")
           all_plots[[key]] <- p
           panel_data <- bind_rows(panel_data, meta_res %>% mutate(subgroup=sg$name, level=lvl, n_group=n_sub))
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  tryCatch(
    write_csv(panel_data, paste0("Results/Metaanalysis/Meta_DCA_Subgroups_All_", file_suffix, "_Data.csv")),
    error = function(e) {
      message("Could not write original CSV, writing to _replot version.")
      write_csv(panel_data, paste0("Results/Metaanalysis/Meta_DCA_Subgroups_All_", file_suffix, "_Data_replot.csv"))
    }
  )
  
  layout_keys <- c(
    "Gender_Male", "Gender_Female", "Aboriginal_Indigenous", "Aboriginal_Non-Indigenous",
    "HIV_Negative", "HIV_Positive", "HBV_Negative", "HBV_Positive",
    "Hazardous alcohol use_No", "Hazardous alcohol use_Yes", "Obesity_Not obese (BMI < 30)", "Obesity_Obese (BMI >= 30)"
  )
  
  plot_list_ordered <- map(layout_keys, ~ {
    if(!is.null(all_plots[[.x]])) all_plots[[.x]] else plot_spacer()
  })
  
  if (length(plot_list_ordered) > 0) {
    final_panel <- wrap_plots(plot_list_ordered, ncol = 4) + 
      plot_layout(guides = "collect") & 
      theme(legend.position = "bottom")
      
    ggsave(paste0("Results/Metaanalysis/Meta_DCA_Panel_Subgroups_", file_suffix, ".png"), final_panel, width = 16, height = 12, bg = "white")
  }
}

make_overall_dca_plot_from_csv <- function(file_suffix, panel_title, x_max = 0.20, y_limits = NULL) {
  in_file <- paste0("Results/Metaanalysis/Meta_PooledNB_", file_suffix, ".csv")
  if (!file.exists(in_file)) return(NULL)

  df <- readr::read_csv(in_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    filter(is.finite(threshold), threshold <= x_max)

  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)

  df <- df %>% arrange(strategy, threshold)

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = threshold, y = nb_pooled, color = strategy, linetype = strategy, group = strategy)) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE, span = 0.6, linewidth = 1) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, x_max), ylim = y_limits) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, x_max, 0.05),
      labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = panel_title,
      x = "Threshold probability",
      y = "Net benefit",
      color = "Strategy",
      linetype = "Strategy"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "Screen All" = "black",
      "Screen None" = "black",
      "Age > 35" = "#1b9e77",
      "Age > 40" = "#d95f02",
      "Age > 45" = "#7570b3"
    )) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c(
      "Screen All" = "solid",
      "Screen None" = "dotted",
      "Age > 35" = "solid",
      "Age > 40" = "solid",
      "Age > 45" = "solid"
    )) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +  # Base font size for the whole plot
  theme(
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),  # Legend title font
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 14),                 # Legend labels font
    legend.key.size = unit(1.2, "cm"),                      # Size of legend keys
    legend.spacing.x = unit(0.5, "cm"),                     # Horizontal spacing
    legend.spacing.y = unit(0.3, "cm")                      # Vertical spacing
  ) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow=2, byrow=TRUE))

  p
}

abstract_ylim <- c(min(-0.01, abstract_ymin), max(0.1, abstract_ymax * 1.05))

make_nia_plot_from_csv <- function(file_path, panel_title, x_max = 0.30, y_limits = c(0, 50)) {
  if (!file.exists(file_path)) return(NULL)

  df <- readr::read_csv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    filter(is.finite(threshold), threshold <= x_max)

  # Keep figure consistent with the label "positive values only"
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(nia_per_100 = pmax(0, nia_per_100))

  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)

  df <- df %>%
    mutate(strategy = factor(strategy, levels = c("Age > 35", "Age > 40", "Age > 45")))

  ggplot(df, aes(x = threshold, y = nia_per_100, color = strategy, group = strategy)) +
    geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 0, color = "Screen All"), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE, span = 0.6, linewidth = 1.2) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = y_limits) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, x_max, 0.05),
      labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = panel_title,
      x = "Threshold probability",
      y = "Net interventions avoided per 100",
      color = NULL
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "Age > 35" = "#1b9e77",
      "Age > 40" = "#d95f02",
      "Age > 45" = "#7570b3",
      "Screen All" = "black"
    )) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 20) +
